name: login-gate-files
old:
app.all '*splat', (req, res, next) ->
        # don't protect site flag,
        return next() if req.url is '/favicon.png'
        return next() unless /\.(json|html)\/?$/i.test req.path
new:
# login-gate-files: login-to-view also covers what carries a site's content without
      # being page json: uploaded assets, the assets plugin's listings, the farm's MCP door
      # and the xml sitemap. Anonymous requests get 403 Login Required.
      gatedFiles = /^\/(assets|plugin\/assets|system\/api\/mcp|sitemap\.xml)(\/|$)/i

      app.all '*splat', (req, res, next) ->
        # don't protect site flag,
        return next() if req.url is '/favicon.png'
        unless /\.(json|html)\/?$/i.test req.path
          filePath = req.path
          try filePath = decodeURIComponent(filePath).replace(/\/{2,}/g, '/')
          return next() unless gatedFiles.test filePath
          return next() if (isAuthorized(req) and (owner isnt '')) or allowedToView(req)
          return res.status(403).type('text/plain').send('Login Required')
also:
# if configured, enforce restricted access to json
    # assets-list-error-scrub: the assets plugin answers a folder it cannot read with the
    # raw fs error, which names the server's disk path. Pass on only the error code.
    app.get '/plugin/assets/list', (req, res, next) ->
      send = res.json.bind(res)
      res.json = (body) ->
        body.error = {code: body.error.code or 'ERROR'} if body?.error
        send body
      next()
    # Its index throws on a site with no assets folder, and the error page carries a
    # stack trace with server paths. No folder means no files.
    app.get '/plugin/assets/index', (req, res, next) ->
      return res.json([]) unless fs.existsSync(argv.assets)
      next()

    # if configured, enforce restricted access to json
